Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Dean Parisot’s father was “Jerome Menke” based on a single, likely erroneous/vandalized snapshot of Wikipedia without cross-verifying against independent sources. This misread also conflated the surname of Dean’s spouse (Menke) with his father. Proper corroboration (later found on updated Wikipedia, IMDb trivia, and other sources) shows the father is Aldo Parisot.
